item.title: Auro Hotels adds Courtyard by Marriott Greenville Downtown
item.description: Auro Hotels adds the Courtyard by Marriott Greenville Downtown, a 135-room hotel near Main Street, expanding its Greenville hospitality portfolio. The post Auro Hotels adds Courtyard by Marriott Greenville Downtown appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: That wall between design and manufacturing that still exists
item.description: South Carolina must move beyond build-to-print manufacturing and invest in design and innovation hubs to fuel long-term growth and global competitiveness. The post That wall between design and manufacturing that still exists appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Julie Kunkle promoted to director at S.C. Commerce
item.description: Julie Kunkle has been promoted to director of global business development at the South Carolina Department of Commerce following six years as deputy director. The post Julie Kunkle promoted to director at S.C. Commerce appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Continental Realty buys Elevate at Brighton Park
item.description: Continental Realty Corp. acquires the 329-unit Elevate at Brighton Park apartments in Summerville’s Nexton community, expanding its Charleston multifamily portfolio. The post Continental Realty buys Elevate at Brighton Park appeared first on SCBiz.

item.description: As businesses across South Carolina face rapid change from technological disruption to workforce challenges many are rethinking what leadership development should look like. The post Furman University’s Center for Innovative Leadership is redefining how organizations build leaders appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Airsys establishes Hungary manufacturing facility

item.title: The Alliance mixed-use project to start on Laurens Road
item.description: Work will soon begin on The Alliance, a $38 million mixed-use development on Laurens Road bringing affordable housing and retail to Nicholtown. The post The Alliance mixed-use project to start on Laurens Road appeared first on SCBiz.

item.title: Orangeburg County names Ty Davenport executive director

item.title: Carolina-native joins Iron Rose as executive chef

item.title: Chris Cook | ADC Engineering
